### Gotta Catch the Flag!
A familiar adventure awaits! Take a trip down memory lane with a modified copy of the classic Pokémon Red.
But something isn't quite right... There's more to this game than meets the eye, and somewhere within its nostalgic world lies a secret waiting to be uncovered.
Explore, experiment, and see if you can uncover what was hidden in this modified version of the game.
Your objective: Find the hidden flag and prove you're the very best, like no one ever was.
Good luck, Trainer!
